title: Landscape package for a new Langford townhouse build

seo.title: Sample project: Langford townhouse landscape | RNC
seo.description: Sample project: a soft landscape package for a new Langford townhouse site, built to the contractor's drawings in phases.

summary: Soft landscaping for a new townhouse site, built to the general contractor's drawings.
scope: Tree and shrub planting to plan
challenge: The general contractor needed the landscaping finished in phases as each building block closed out.
approach: We worked to the landscape drawings: topsoil and fine grading, sod for the common lawns, planting and irrigation. Plant species and sizes came from the drawings.
Deliveries were coordinated with the site supervisor, and we attended a deficiency walkthrough at the end of each phase.
result: Landscape phases completed to the drawings and handed over with deficiencies closed.
